title: Motus: higher-order Ambisonic room impulse responses and 3D models with varying furniture

units.future_room_impulse_response: digital signal samples with sampling and Ambisonic conventions declared by the dataset files

measurement_uncertainty.description: The registered Zenodo record does not provide a channel-level uncertainty model suitable for NexusEP comparison.

known_gaps: Only the 7,911-byte Zenodo metadata record was downloaded; none of the seven dataset archives was acquired.
The Zenodo inventory totals 63,649,043,963 bytes and supplies MD5 rather than SHA-256 checksums for the archives; NexusEP must record local SHA-256 after any future download.

Motus contains 3,320 room impulse responses from 830 furniture configurations and four source-receiver configurations in one room; it is not evidence for generic façade or interzone transmission loss.
NexusEP has no impulse-response, frequency-dependent absorption, reflection, or reverberation model, so Motus is scientifically mismatched to ACOUST-0.

preprocessing.description: Verify DOI, version, CC BY 4.0 license, seven-file inventory, total byte size, and metadata checksum without downloading the dataset archives.

permitted_use.purpose: Future empirical validation of an implemented room-impulse-response or reverberation model.
permitted_use.notes: Do not ingest the 63.6 GB dataset or claim comparison until the relevant NexusEP acoustic state, outputs, metrics, and resource budget are approved.
